## Long-horizon agents, managed for you.

Every agent runs as a managed worker with durable state, full timeline, snapshots, backups, and restore handled by Asteroids.

### Infinitely long continuous history

Keep instructions, files, decisions, and conversation history across long-running work.

### Managed recovery

Snapshots and backups let the agent restore after faults without losing the thread.

### Secure sandbox

Isolated environments boot in seconds with only the tools you attach.

### Tools you can customize

Start with built-in tools, then add prompts, APIs, files, and custom workflows.

### Scale and park

Spin up more agents in seconds. Park idle agents for free until work returns.

### Self-evolving (coming soon)

Your agent distills what it learns into an ever-sharper version of itself.

## Your whole fleet, one command away.

Create and manage agents straight from the terminal. Everything you can do in the UI is scriptable with the CLI.

$ ast agent create --harness claude-code --model opus-4.8 ✓ Eros-55C0 launched in 27s $ ast agent list NAME HARNESS STATUS Eros-55C0 claude-code ready Vesta-9A21 hermes ready $ ast agent set Eros-55C0 --model glm-5.2 ✓ Model swapped — history intact $

No lock-in. Full control.
